purpose: Test the genuinely stronger loophole left after v4.2: arbitrary invertible per-incidence-edge gauges on the topology-changing OR2+XOR3 clause gadget. Work with the actual sum-product tensor obtained after contracting the two private auxiliary bits, rather than incorrectly replacing existential projection by unit-weight OR3. Prove that the weighted composite still cannot satisfy matchgate parity under the Hadamard-type external gauges forced by three degree-3 EQ3 variable nodes.

sum_product_composite.gadget: F1(a,y)=1[a OR NOT y], F2(y,b,z)=1[y XOR b XOR z=1], F3(z,c)=1[NOT z OR c].
sum_product_composite.support: support(H)=OR3, but amplitudes are not uniform because inputs 101 and 111 have two auxiliary witnesses. The proof uses these exact amplitudes.

external_eq3_gauge_classification.fact_from_v2_7: If a degree-3 equality tensor EQ3 becomes pure parity under independent invertible edge transforms, then after harmless nonzero output row scalings each incident variable-side basis has Hadamard type S_j~[[1,r_j],[1,-r_j]] with r_j nonzero.
external_eq3_gauge_classification.dual_constraint_basis: Up to an overall nonzero scalar on each leg, T_j=S_j^(-T)~[[r_j,1],[r_j,-1]].

theorem.name: WEIGHTED_OR2_XOR3_COMPOSITE_CANNOT_HAVE_MATCHGATE_PARITY_ON_THREE_EQ3_EXTERNAL_LEGS
theorem.statement: Let r1,r2,r3 be arbitrary nonzero characteristic-zero scalars and transform the three external legs of H by T_j=[[r_j,1],[r_j,-1]]. The transformed tensor H' has support on both Hamming parities. In fact the sum of its four odd-weight amplitudes is -8 and the sum of its four even-weight amplitudes is +8.
proof: Apply T1 tensor T2 tensor T3. The eight amplitudes are multilinear polynomials in r1,r2,r3 frozen in the exact checker.
Adding the four odd-weight amplitudes H'001+H'010+H'100+H'111 cancels every parameter-dependent monomial and leaves -8.
Adding the four even-weight amplitudes H'000+H'011+H'101+H'110 cancels every parameter-dependent monomial and leaves +8.
Therefore the odd sector cannot vanish identically and the even sector cannot vanish identically. H' is never pure parity, so it cannot be a matchgate signature.
theorem.network_corollary: Suppose every local OR2/XOR3 node of the v4.1 gadget were made a matchgate by arbitrary edge-dependent gauges, with the gauges cancelling on internal y,z wires. Matchgate networks are closed under internal contraction, so the contracted clause gadget would be a matchgate on its three external legs. For a clause whose three external variables are degree-3 EQ3 nodes, the external gauges must have the Hadamard type above, contradicting the theorem.

killed: Use the v4.1 topology-changing two-bit gadget and arbitrary local per-edge holographic gauges to obtain a network of local matchgates/Pfaffian tensors while retaining the original three degree-3 equality endpoints.

Argue that internal auxiliary gauges evade the v2.7 source-return obstruction: after exact contraction they cancel and leave the weighted H tensor, which itself fails parity under every allowed external EQ3 gauge.
not_killed: A genuinely nonlocal transformation coupling multiple clauses before matchgate/Pfaffian reduction.
Topology changes that also replace or globally couple the original EQ3 fanout nodes rather than leaving three independent degree-3 equality endpoints.
A new global affine-bijunctive minimax/augmentation theorem.
